sections.heading: Trigonometric Functions & Circular Measure Practice Exercises

questions.q: A circle sector has radius \( r = 6 \text{ cm} \) and central angle \( \theta = \frac{\pi}{3} \text{ rad} \). What is the arc length of the sector?
questions.answer: Arc length formula in radians: \( s = r\theta = (6)\left(\frac{\pi}{3}\right) = \frac{6\pi}{3} \text{ cm} \).
